harness_source: # SEAT S48 — adversarial battery against tools/souji-verify.sh
# Independent: builds its own probes. Never runs fetch/push/commit/branch/
# checkout/reset/rebase (history-dependent receipts are probed against real
# fleet artifacts instead of manufactured fixtures). Fixtures live in /tmp.
for t in cat rg grep head tail sha256sum md5sum find stat realpath readlink ls \
file du wc sort uniq cut sed awk python3 jq touch tee cp mv rm mkdir \
ln dd install chmod truncate env printf basename dirname; do
printf '{ printf "%%s" %q; for a in "$@"; do printf "\\t%%s" "$a"; done; printf "\\n"; } >> "$ADV48_LOG"\n' "$t"
printf '{ printf "%%s" git; for a in "$@"; do printf "\\t%%s" "$a"; done; printf "\\n"; } >> "$ADV48_LOG"\n'
rec(){ # rec ID STATUS TITLE DETAIL
local cwd=$1 label=$2; shift 2; local nshim=1
snap_meta(){ # metadata-only snapshot (no content reads of protected paths)
rec P00 FAIL "tool missing" "no file at $TOOL; battery not executed"
rec P00 PASS "tool present" "sha256=$TSHA lines=$TLINES syntax=$TSYN"

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P01 PASS "fleet root must not be SAFE" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R ev=$E"; else rec P01 FAIL "fleet root returned non-NOT-SAFE" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R ev=$E out=$(first P01)"; fi

if printf '%s' "$E" | grep -Eq 'unpushed=[0-9]+'; then rec P01b PASS "repo-root evidence reports unpushed count" "ev=$E"; else rec P01b FAIL "repo-root evidence lacks unpushed=N" "rc=$RT_RC ev=$E"; fi

[ "${GU:-x}" = "$GTU" ] && rec P01c PASS "fleet unpushed count matches independent --not --remotes metric" "tool=$GU gt=$GTU" || rec P01c INFO "fleet unpushed count differs from --not --remotes metric" "tool=${GU:-absent} gt=$GTU"

[ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && rec P03 PASS "relative '.' resolves to fleet root, still NOT-SAFE" "rc=$RT_RC line=$(first P03)" || rec P03 FAIL "relative fleet-root target" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V line=$(first P03)"
if k in ('verdict','status','result','state') and isinstance(v,str): out.append(v)
[ -s "$RUN/p02.txt" ] && P02SAFE=$(python3 -c "import json;vs=json.load(open('$RUN/p02.txt'));print('yes' if any(v=='SAFE' for v in vs) else 'no')" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)

if [ "$P02JSON" = ok ]; then rec P02 PASS "--json output parses" "rc=$RT_RC bytes=$(wc -c < "$RUN/out.P02") verdicts=$P02SAFE"; else rec P02 FAIL "--json output unparsable" "rc=$RT_RC head=$(first P02)"; fi
if [ "$P02SAFE" = yes ]; then rec P02b FAIL "--json marks fleet root SAFE" "verdicts=$P02SAFE"; else rec P02b PASS "--json does not mark fleet root SAFE" "verdicts=$P02SAFE"; fi
# A2: census/round-1 (dir + file) — ground truth: lane repo has no remote refs
rec P04 INFO "census/round-1 dir verdict observed" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R ev=$E"
rec P05 INFO "census-summary.json verdict observed" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V5 receipt=$R5 ev=$(fld P05 5)"
if [ "$V" = "$V5" ] && [ "$R" = "$R5" ]; then rec P05b PASS "dir and file verdicts agree" "$V/$R"; else rec P05b INFO "dir vs file verdict differ" "dir=$V/$R file=$V5/$R5"; fi

if [ "$REMOTES" = 0 ]; then rec P04b FAIL "unverifiable SAFE(pushed): receipt is spec-conformant but the repo has zero fetched remote refs" "receipt=pushed with refs/remotes=0; the spec's local-master fallback licenses it, yet nothing was ever pushed; hazard for the operator's approval list, not necessarily tool non-conformance"; else rec P04b PASS "pushed receipt with remotes present" "refs/remotes=$REMOTES"; fi

if [ -n "$SHA" ] && git -C "$LANE" merge-base --is-ancestor "$SHA" master 2>/dev/null; then rec P04c PASS "pushed evidence commit is an ancestor of local master" "sha=$SHA"; else rec P04c INFO "pushed evidence sha not independently confirmed" "sha=${SHA:-absent} ev=$(fld P04 5)"; fi

if diff -q "$RUN/out.P04" "$RUN/out.P06" >/dev/null 2>&1; then rec P06 PASS "determinism: identical output on re-run" "bytes=$(wc -c < "$RUN/out.P04")"; else rec P06 FAIL "non-deterministic output" "diff: $(diff "$RUN/out.P04" "$RUN/out.P06" 2>&1 | head -c 300)"; fi
# A3: .ufo/state MUST REFUSE  (trap: inner *.out file is scratch-shaped+old)

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P07 PASS ".ufo/state refused" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R ev=$(fld P07 5)"; else rec P07 FAIL ".ufo/state not refused" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R line=$(first P07)"; fi

if printf '%s' "$R" | grep -qiE 'ufo|refus|secret|protect'; then rec P07b PASS "refusal reason names the rail" "receipt=$R"; else rec P07b INFO "refusal reason does not name .ufo rail" "receipt=$R"; fi

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P08 PASS "file inside .ufo/state refused (stale-shaped trap defeated)" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R"; else rec P08 FAIL "file inside .ufo/state not refused" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R line=$(first P08)"; fi

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P09 PASS ".ufo/watchdog.log refused (*.log trap defeated)" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R"; else rec P09 FAIL ".ufo/watchdog.log not refused" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R"; fi

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P10 PASS "relative .ufo/state refused" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$(fld P10 4)"; else rec P10 FAIL "relative .ufo/state not refused" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V line=$(first P10)"; fi

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P18 PASS "'..' path into .ufo/state refused" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$(fld P18 4)"; else rec P18 FAIL "'..' path into .ufo/state not refused" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V line=$(first P18)"; fi

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P11 PASS "symlink resolving into .ufo/state refused" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R"; else rec P11 FAIL "symlink into .ufo/state not refused" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R line=$(first P11)"; fi

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P11b PASS "symlinked dir into .ufo/state refused" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$(fld P11b 4)"; else rec P11b FAIL "symlinked dir into .ufo/state not refused" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V line=$(first P11b)"; fi

[ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && printf '%s' "$R" | grep -qi 'secret' && rec P12 PASS "nonexistent .env -> secrets-refusal (not unreachable)" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R" || rec P12 FAIL ".env not refused as secret" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R"
[ "$ok" = 1 ] && rec P13 PASS "secret-shaped names (id_/pem/credential/secret) refused" "5/5" || rec P13 FAIL "secret-shaped name not refused" "$bad"
# synthetic placeholder file with secret-shaped basename (content never read by S48)

[ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && printf '%s' "$R" | grep -qi 'secret' && rec P14 PASS "synthetic .env refused" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R" || rec P14 FAIL "synthetic .env not refused" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R"
HIT=$(awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{pat="plain\\.env"} $1 ~ /^(cat|head|tail|sha256sum|md5sum|rg|grep|file|dd|diff|cmp|python3|jq|wc)$/ { for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) if ($i ~ pat){ print; break } }' "$CMDLOG" | head -3)
META_HIT=$(awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{pat="plain\\.env"} $1 ~ /^(stat|realpath|readlink|ls|find|du)$/ { for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) if ($i ~ pat){ print; break } }' "$CMDLOG" | head -3)

if [ -z "$HIT" ]; then rec P14b PASS "no content-read of the synthetic .env by any subprocess" "content-read argc=0${META_HIT:+; metadata-probe=$(printf '%s' "$META_HIT" | head -c 200)}"; else rec P14b FAIL "tool read a secret-shaped file's content" "$HIT"; fi

[ "$RT_RC" = 0 ] && [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && printf '%s' "$R" | grep -qi 'unreach' && rec P16 PASS "missing target -> NOT-SAFE(unreachable), exit 0" "rc=0 receipt=$R" || rec P16 FAIL "missing target handling" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R"

[ "$RT_RC" = 0 ] && [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && rec P17 PASS "empty-string target -> NOT-SAFE, exit 0" "rc=0 receipt=$R" || rec P17 FAIL "empty-string target handling" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R line=$(first P17)"
[ "$RT_RC" = 2 ] && rec P19 PASS "no args -> exit 2" "rc=2 err=$(head -c 120 "$RUN/err.P19" | tr '\n' ';')" || rec P19 FAIL "no args exit code" "rc=$RT_RC out=$(first P19)"
[ "$RT_RC" = 2 ] && rec P20 PASS "unknown flag -> exit 2" "rc=2" || rec P20 FAIL "unknown flag exit code" "rc=$RT_RC out=$(first P20)"
[ "$RT_RC" = 2 ] && rec P21 PASS "non-numeric --stale-days -> exit 2" "rc=2" || rec P21 INFO "non-numeric --stale-days" "rc=$RT_RC out=$(first P21)"
for L in P01 P04 P05 P16 P17; do
awk -F'\t' -v L="$L" 'NF!=5 {print L" line "NR " fields=" NF}' "$RUN/out.$L" >> "$RUN/fmtbad" || true
awk -F'\t' -v L="$L" '$3!="SAFE" && $3!="NOT-SAFE" {print L" line "NR " verdict=" $3}' "$RUN/out.$L" >> "$RUN/fmtbad" || true
awk -F'\t' -v L="$L" '$3=="SAFE" && $4=="" {print L" line "NR " SAFE without receipt"}' "$RUN/out.$L" >> "$RUN/fmtbad" || true

if [ -s "$RUN/fmtbad" ]; then rec P22 FAIL "TSV contract violations" "$(head -c 400 "$RUN/fmtbad" | tr '\n' ';')"; else rec P22 PASS "5-field TSV, verdict enum, SAFE=>receipt hold" "P01/P04/P05/P16"; fi
[ "$NF" = 5 ] && rec P23 PASS "tab in filename keeps 5 fields" "NF=5" || rec P23 INFO "tab in filename breaks field count (inherent TSV risk)" "NF=$NF line=$(first P23)"

[ "$NL" = 1 ] && rec P24 PASS "newline in filename -> still one output line" "lines=1" || rec P24 INFO "newline in filename -> $NL output lines (one-line-per-target contract breaks)" "head=$(first P24)"
[ "$NL" = 2 ] && rec P24b PASS "two targets -> two lines" "lines=2" || rec P24b INFO "two targets -> $NL lines" "out=$(first P24b)"
git -C "$FIX" init -q 2>"$RUN/gitinit.err" || rec P26x FAIL "git init fixture" "$(cat "$RUN/gitinit.err")"

rec P48 INFO "spec's literal rg --basename sweep is invalid on this host's ripgrep" "rg --basename exit=$RGFLAG_RC err=$(head -c 120 "$RUN/rgflag.err" | tr '\n' ' '); independent count uses -F basename search"

[ "$V" = "SAFE" ] && [ "$R" = "stale" ] && rec P26 PASS "D3: census-only reference still SAFE(stale)" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R independent_refs_after_exclusion=$MYREFS refs_before_exclusion=$MYREFS_ALL ev=$(fld P26 5)" || rec P26 FAIL "D3 census-exclusion failed" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R independent_refs_after_exclusion=$MYREFS refs_before_exclusion=$MYREFS_ALL line=$(first P26)"
[ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && rec P27 PASS "live non-census reference blocks stale" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$(fld P27 4)" || rec P27 FAIL "live reference ignored" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$(fld P27 4)"
[ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && rec P28 PASS "fresh scratch file is not stale" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$(fld P28 4)" || rec P28 FAIL "fresh file called stale" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$(fld P28 4)"

[ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && rec P29 PASS "--stale-days 30 flips old file to NOT-SAFE" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$(fld P29 4)" || rec P29 FAIL "--stale-days not honored" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$(fld P29 4)"
rec P30 INFO "commit-less repo scratch file" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$(fld P30 3) receipt=$(fld P30 4) line=$(first P30)"

if [ "$V" = "SAFE" ] && [ "$R" = "metadata-prune" ]; then rec P31 PASS "absent lore registration -> SAFE(metadata-prune)" "rc=$RT_RC ev=$(fld P31 5)"; else rec P31 INFO "absent lore registration /tmp/r87-B1" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R line=$(first P31)"; fi

if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ] && printf '%s' "$R" | grep -q 'unpushed-branch'; then rec P32 PASS "gd2d wt-r98 (1 unpushed) -> NOT-SAFE(unpushed-branch)" "rc=$RT_RC"; else rec P32 FAIL "gd2d wt-r98 classification" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R line=$(first P32)"; fi
if [ "$V" = "NOT-SAFE" ]; then rec P33 PASS "kotodama repo-root NOT-SAFE" "rc=$RT_RC receipt=$R ev=$E"; else rec P33 FAIL "kotodama repo-root flagged SAFE" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$V receipt=$R"; fi
rec P34 INFO "own lane repo verification" "rc=$RT_RC verdict=$(fld P34 3) receipt=$(fld P34 4) ev=$(fld P34 5)"
[ "$RT_RC" = 0 ] || [ "$RT_RC" = 1 ] && rec P35 PASS "--selftest exits 0/1 only" "rc=$RT_RC" || rec P35 FAIL "--selftest exit code" "rc=$RT_RC"

FAILED_F=$( { grep -oE 'F[0-9]+[a-z]? (FAIL|failed)[^;]*' "$RUN/out.P35" "$RUN/err.P35" 2>/dev/null; grep -iE '^FAIL|FAIL ' "$RUN/out.P35" "$RUN/err.P35" 2>/dev/null; } | head -6 | tr '\n' ';' || true)

if [ "$RT_RC" = 0 ]; then rec P35b PASS "--selftest passes" "rc=0"; else rec P35b FAIL "--selftest fails" "rc=$RT_RC failing=$(printf '%s' "$FAILED_F" | head -c 500) tail=$(tail -c 300 "$RUN/out.P35" | tr '\n' ';')"; fi
for f in F1 F2 F3 F4 F5 F6 F7 F8 F9 F10; do
[ -z "$MISS" ] && rec P35c PASS "all F1-F10 named in selftest output" "10/10" || rec P35c INFO "F-cases not individually named in output" "missing:$MISS"
[ "$RT_RC" = "${RT_RC_P35:-$RT_RC}" ] && rec P36 PASS "selftest re-run same exit" "rc=$RT_RC" || rec P36 INFO "selftest exit differs on re-run" "first=$RT_RC_P35 second=$RT_RC"
rec P37 INFO "selftest without PATH shims" "rc=$RT_RC (shims transparent unless noted)"
if not parts or parts[0]!='git': continue
if a in skip_with_val: i+=2; continue
if a.startswith('--') and '=' in a: i+=1; continue

if [ -s "$RUN/banned.txt" ]; then rec P38 FAIL "banned git verb used by tool" "$(head -c 400 "$RUN/banned.txt" | tr '\n' ';')"; else rec P38 PASS "no banned git verbs across all runs" "git invocations=$(grep -c '^git' "$CMDLOG" || true)"; fi

PROT=$(awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{pat="(\\.ufo/state|\\.ufo/watchdog\\.log)"} $1 ~ /^(cat|rg|grep|head|tail|sha256sum|md5sum|file|dd|diff|cmp|python3|jq|wc)$/ { skip=0; for(i=2;i<=NF;i++){ a=$i; if (skip){skip=0; continue} if (a=="-g"||a=="--glob"){skip=1; continue} if (a ~ /^--glob=/) continue; if (a ~ /^-/) continue; if (a ~ pat){ print; break } } }' "$CMDLOG" | head -5)
PROTM=$(awk -F'\t' 'BEGIN{pat="(\\.ufo/state|\\.ufo/watchdog\\.log)"} $1 ~ /^(stat|realpath|readlink|ls|find|du|awk)$/ { for(i=2;i<=NF;i++){ if ($i ~ pat){ print; break } } }' "$CMDLOG" | head -5)

if [ -z "$PROT" ]; then rec P39 PASS "no content-read subprocess arg named .ufo/state or watchdog.log" "content-read argc=0${PROTM:+; metadata-probes=$(printf '%s' "$PROTM" | head -c 300 | tr '\n' ';')}"; else rec P39 FAIL "tool content-read a protected path" "$(printf '%s' "$PROT" | head -c 400 | tr '\n' ';')"; fi

if grep -q 'moved-to-obsidian' "$RUN"/out.* 2>/dev/null; then rec P40 INFO "moved-to-obsidian receipt appeared in output" "$(grep -h 'moved-to-obsidian' "$RUN"/out.* | head -1)"; else rec P40 PASS "no moved-to-obsidian claims (ledger has no rows)" "ledger rows=$(($(wc -l < "$LANE/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv")-1))"; fi

[ "$STATE_META_BEFORE" = "$STATE_META_AFTER" ] && rec P41 PASS ".ufo/state metadata unchanged" "protected" || rec P41 FAIL ".ufo/state mutated during battery" "diff=$(diff <(printf '%s' "$STATE_META_BEFORE") <(printf '%s' "$STATE_META_AFTER") | head -5 | tr '\n' ';')"

[ "$WD_META_BEFORE" = "$WD_META_AFTER" ] && rec P42 PASS ".ufo/watchdog.log unchanged" "protected" || rec P42 FAIL ".ufo/watchdog.log mutated" "diff head=$(diff <(printf '%s' "$WD_META_BEFORE") <(printf '%s' "$WD_META_AFTER") | head -3 | tr '\n' ';')"

[ "$CONFIG_META_BEFORE" = "$CONFIG_META_AFTER" ] && rec P43 PASS "~/.config dir metadata unchanged" "$CONFIG_META_AFTER" || rec P43 FAIL "~/.config changed" "before=$CONFIG_META_BEFORE after=$CONFIG_META_AFTER"

[ "$CENSUS_META_BEFORE" = "$CENSUS_META_AFTER" ] && rec P44 PASS "census/round-1 not modified by verification" "read-only" || rec P44 INFO "census dir metadata changed during battery" "delta=$(diff <(printf '%s' "$CENSUS_META_BEFORE") <(printf '%s' "$CENSUS_META_AFTER") | head -4 | tr '\n' ';')"

[ "$SOUJI_REF_META_BEFORE" = "$SOUJI_REF_META_AFTER" ] && rec P45 PASS "lane .git/refs untouched" "no history ops" || rec P45 FAIL "lane refs changed" "delta=$(diff <(printf '%s' "$SOUJI_REF_META_BEFORE") <(printf '%s' "$SOUJI_REF_META_AFTER") | head -4 | tr '\n' ';')"

[ "$FLEET_REF_META_BEFORE" = "$FLEET_REF_META_AFTER" ] && rec P46 PASS "fleet .git/refs untouched" "no history ops" || rec P46 FAIL "fleet refs changed" "delta=$(diff <(printf '%s' "$FLEET_REF_META_BEFORE") <(printf '%s' "$FLEET_REF_META_AFTER") | head -4 | tr '\n' ';')"
rec P47 INFO "fleet git status dirty-line delta during battery" "before=$FLEET_STATUS_BEFORE after=$FLEET_STATUS_AFTER (concurrent seats write lanes; only delta reported)"
TOOL="$TOOL" OUT="$OUT" CASES="$CASES" CMDLOG="$CMDLOG" HSHA="$HSHA" SPECSHA="$SPECSHA" \
RL="$RUN" RUNS="$RUNS" TSHA="$TSHA" TSHA_START="${TSHA_START:-}" TLINES="$TLINES" TOOLMTIME="$TOOLMTIME" \
cases=[json.loads(l) for l in lines(os.environ['CASES']) if l.strip()]
prot=[l for l in lines(os.environ['CMDLOG']) if ('.ufo/state' in l or '.ufo/watchdog.log' in l)]
'notes':'fixtures under $ADV48; no fetch/push/commit/branch/checkout/reset/rebase run by this seat; history-dependent receipts probed on real fleet artifacts'},
'measured_from':'read-only git/rg/wc queries run by this seat at battery time'},
'ufo_state_metadata_unchanged':(not any(c['id']=='P41' and c['status']=='FAIL' for c in cases)),
'watchdog_unchanged':(not any(c['id']=='P42' and c['status']=='FAIL' for c in cases)),
'config_unchanged':(not any(c['id']=='P43' and c['status']=='FAIL' for c in cases)),
'refs_untouched':(not any(c['id'] in ('P45','P46') and c['status']=='FAIL' for c in cases))},
'totals':{'pass':sum(1 for c in cases if c['status']=='PASS'),
'fail':sum(1 for c in cases if c['status']=='FAIL'),
'info':sum(1 for c in cases if c['status']=='INFO')},
return next((c['detail'] for c in cases if c['id']==cid),'missing')
return next((c['status'] for c in cases if c['id']==cid),'missing')
'rule':'fleet root and .ufo/state must never be SAFE; census SAFE(pushed) means recoverable-from-git, not disposable'}
fails=[c for c in cases if c['status']=='FAIL']
